{{Quote|I once rewired a scout ship so that the retro-rockets took out a roomful o' senators. This won't be a problem, sweetie!|Heff Arcon, to [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Out">{{TCWComicCite|6.30|Out}}</ref>}}
'''Heff Arcon''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the war, Arcon once wired a scout ship which [[Death/Legends|killed]] an entire room full of senators that represented themselves in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. Eventually, Arcon was captured by the Republic along with 49 other of the most dangerous criminals on [[M'Bardi]] and would be shipped to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While been guarded by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], the cruiser was attacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. The cruiser's main reactor was damaged, causing the cells to open and the prisoners who therefore can attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. While the Jedi were trying to hold the prisoners, the crew tried to repair the reactor until they ultimately failed. Arcon was among those to cooperate and helped Ahsoka repair the outside of the ship. Skywalker thanked Arcon and the prisoners for helping and guaranteed that their aid will affect their parole.
